_comment: Follow-up cases for run-conversation-eval.mjs. Each case is a conversation whose LAST turn refers back to the earlier turns, so the words that identify the page live in the history and not in the question. The question alone must not retrieve the page; the history must. These are the cases a fix that drops the history from the ranking query would break, and they are hand-written because anaphora is not derivable from a link graph. The pages are real pages of the production vault.
